description: This file defines the class 'mantisdbInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface'. It provides integration with a MantisBT issue tracker database, including methods for connecting, retrieving issues, checking status, and generating URLs. It also includes configuration templates and status mappings specific to MantisBT.

classes.name: mantisdbInterface
classes.description: A class that integrates TestLink with MantisBT issue tracker database, providing issue retrieval, status checks, and configuration capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, connects to the bug tracker database, and sets default statuses and configurations.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Generates a URL to view a bug on the MantisBT interface based on the bug ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific issue from the database, returning an object with details including status, summary, and visual representations.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the status string (verbose) of a bug given its ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug ID exists in the database, returning 1 if it does.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a bug ID, using a numeric check.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates an HTML string representing the bug's status, optionally decorated with language-specific labels.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP information from the configuration.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuring the MantisBT integration.

methods.name: setStatusCfg
methods.description: Loads custom status codes and colors from the configuration to override defaults.

methods.name: getCodeStatus
methods.description: Returns the mapping of status codes to verbose descriptions.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns the mapping of verbose status descriptions to color codes.
